module.name: hover-card
module.title: HoverCard
module.description: The HoverCard renderer and its options.

ui.name: hover-card
ui.summary: Renders a preview that opens on hover *and* focus.
ui.guidance: Focus is not optional: a panel that only opens on hover is unreachable by keyboard and on touch, where there is no hover state at all. The content is a description rather than a label, because the trigger already has a name and replacing it with a paragraph of preview text would make the link unreadable in a screen reader's link list.
ui.keyboard: The trigger is focusable and opens the card on focus as well as hover, and Escape closes it.
